molecules.name: Amino acids
molecules.note: The model lumps all amino acids. Shown: L-glutamine, the most abundant free amino acid in plasma.

molecules.name: Lipids
molecules.note: The model lumps all lipids. Shown: palmitic acid, a common circulating fatty acid.

molecules.name: T3 / T4 activity
molecules.note: Shown: triiodothyronine (T3), the active form.

molecules.name: ADH / vasopressin
molecules.note: Arginine vasopressin as bound to the V2 receptor; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: CCK
molecules.note: Shown: CCK-8, the active C-terminal fragment, as bound to the CCK-A receptor.

molecules.name: Glucagon
molecules.note: Porcine glucagon; the sequence is identical to human.

molecules.name: CRH
molecules.note: As bound to the CRF1 receptor; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: ACTH
molecules.note: The receptor-binding N-terminal segment resolved in the MC2R complex; the rest of ACTH(1-39) has no deposited structure.

molecules.name: TSH
molecules.note: Native human TSH as bound to its receptor; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: ANP
molecules.note: As bound to the GC-A receptor; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: Gastrin
molecules.note: Gastrin-17 as bound to the CCK-B receptor; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: Secretin
molecules.note: As bound to the secretin receptor; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: GLP-1
molecules.note: As bound to the GLP-1 receptor extracellular domain; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: Ghrelin
molecules.note: The segment resolved in the ghrelin receptor complex; the receptor is not shown.

molecules.name: LH
molecules.note: No LH structure is deposited. Shown: human chorionic gonadotropin, which shares LH's alpha subunit, binds the same receptor and has a closely related beta subunit.

molecules.name: Inhibin B
molecules.note: No inhibin B structure is deposited. Shown: activin A, a related dimer of the same TGF-beta family built from inhibin beta chains.

molecules.name: PTH
molecules.note: Shown: PTH(1-34), the biologically active fragment.

molecules.name: Antibody (IgG)
molecules.note: One intact human IgG1 antibody (b12). Plasma IgG is a mixture of many antibodies with this overall shape.

molecules.name: Fibrinogen
molecules.note: The crystallised core of one fibrinogen molecule; flexible regions that did not resolve are missing.

molecules.name: Red blood cell
molecules.citation: Evans E, Fung YC. Improved measurements of the erythrocyte geometry. Microvasc Res 1972;4:335-347 (R0 3.91 um, C0 0.81, C2 7.83, C4 -4.39 um)
molecules.note: Average resting shape: 7.82 um across, 0.81 um thick at the centre, 2.57 um at the rim. The profile coefficients are those widely reproduced from the paper and were not re-checked against its full text. Real red cells deform as they flow.

molecules.name: Platelet
molecules.citation: Moskalensky AE et al. Determination of volume, shape and refractive index of individual blood platelets (arXiv 0807.4673): diameter 2 to 4 um, thickness 0.5 to 2 um. Drawn 2.5 by 0.9 um.
molecules.note: Resting discoid shape as a smooth lens; surface detail is not modelled.

molecules.name: White blood cell
molecules.citation: Neutrophil diameter in suspension, average 8.85 um (Wikipedia, Neutrophil; tertiary source)
molecules.note: A ruffled sphere the size of a neutrophil. The five white cell types are not distinguished.
